description: Migrated from the v1 allowlist (dialog/fs/path/window/shell). The frontend (src/js/*.js) only calls our own #[tauri::command] functions via invoke() and prints via DOM window.print() — it never touches __TAURI__.fs/shell/path/dialog/window. All file I/O and the open/save pickers are Rust-side (open_file/save_file via DialogExt). So only core:default is needed; the tauri-plugin-dialog plugin must still be registered in main.rs. The v1 fs scope had no frontend consumer and is intentionally not reproduced.
